plumbing:orphan_config_field:core/binary.note: kept: spec-defined ELF section-header member (2026-08-17 config-orphan pass). The canonical .dynstr resolution is sections[dynsym.sh_link]; today elf.py matches by name+type (elf.py:198-205), which fails on renamed sections from exotic toolchains — sh_link is the upgrade path. Struct unpack offsets come from the format string, so the field is layout-inert.

plumbing:orphan_config_field:core/llm/to.note: kept: published observability API (2026-08-17 config-orphan pass).
